issues.description: The problem statement text incorrectly specifies addGuestStudents(String) while the UML diagram, template TODOs, and the solution implementation use addGuestStudents(int). This mismatch in the parameter type (String vs int) can confuse students about which signature to implement and will cause failures when tests expect an int parameter.
issues.suggestedFix: Correct the problem statement to specify addGuestStudents(int) to match the UML, template TODOs, and the solution implementation (or alternatively adjust the UML and tests to expect a String if that was intended). Preferably change the text 'addGuestStudents(String)' to 'addGuestStudents(int)'.

issues.description: The problem statement text describes the method as addGuestStudents(String) while the UML in the same problem statement and the solution implementation define addGuestStudents(int). This mismatch between the method parameter type in the narrative and the expected/intended signature (int) can confuse students about the required method signature and how to implement or call it.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the parameter type consistent across artifacts. Preferably update problem_statement.md to specify addGuestStudents(int) to match the UML and the solution implementation. Alternatively, if a String is intended, update the UML, template, and solution to accept a String and document how it should be interpreted/parsed.
